title: Benchmarking Multilingual Document Understanding in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.14758v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform strongly on multimodal tasks, Document Understanding (DU) among them, but the benchmarks that measure them mostly cover English documents and narrow problems. How well current VLMs generalize across languages, tasks, styles and layouts therefore remains unclear. We introduce MDU, a multilingual DU benchmark of 23146 examples spanning 13 tasks and five languages: English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish. The tasks isolate complementary capabilities, from surface-level text and Markdown extraction through summarization, classification and named-entity recognition to layout-sensitive passage and layout extraction. We evaluate 45 state-of-the-art open-weight VLMs from 1.7B to 235B parameters, plus one commercial system under the same protocol. The benchmark is far from saturated: the best average is 69.0, only eight of the 45 evaluated systems reach 65, and the two best results come from 27

translated_title: 视觉语言模型中的多语言文档理解基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.14758v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：近期的视觉语言模型（VLM）在多模态任务上表现强劲，其中包括文档理解（DU），但衡量它们的基准大多只覆盖英文文档和较为狭窄的问题。因此，当前VLM在语言、任务、风格和布局方面的泛化能力如何仍不清楚。我们提出了MDU，一个多语言文档理解基准，包含23146个示例，涵盖13个任务和五种语言：英语、法语、德语、意大利语和西班牙语。这些任务各自隔离了互补的能力，从表层的文本和Markdown提取，到摘要、分类和命名实体识别，再到对布局敏感的段落与布局提取。我们在相同的协议下评估了45个最先进的开源权重VLM（参数量从17亿到2350亿），外加一个商业系统。该基准远未饱和：最佳平均成绩仅为69.0，45个被评估系统中只有8个达到65分，而两个最佳结果来自27（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了覆盖5种语言、13个任务、23146个示例的多语言文档理解基准MDU，通过对45个先进VLM的评估表明该基准远未饱和（最佳平均分仅69.0），揭示了当前视觉语言模型在跨语言、跨任务、跨布局文档理解上的泛化能力仍然有限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MDU, a multilingual document understanding benchmark spanning five languages, 13 tasks, and 23,146 examples, whose evaluation of 45 state-of-the-art VLMs shows the benchmark is far from saturated (best average score of 69.0), revealing that current models generalize poorly across languages, tasks, and layouts.
